metadata.technology_specification: Triple Quadrupole Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometer (Triple Quad LC–MS)
metadata.technology_reasoning: The Triple Quadrupole LC-MS is the industry standard for targeted quantification and trace analysis in complex mixtures, dominating the mass spectrometry market with widespread adoption in pharmaceutical, environmental, and food safety testing due to its sensitivity, specificity, and robustness.

components.reasoning: Core front-end separation module integral to the system, procured as a distinct unit including pumps, autosampler, column, and associated fluidics.
Essential for creating ions from analytes entering the MS; a separate module commonly procured and integrated with distinct supply chains.
Primary mass filter selecting precursor ions; definitive component of a triple quadrupole setup, always present as a discrete unit.

components.component: Collision Cell (Q2) - Quadrupole or RF device
components.reasoning: Central collision-induced dissociation (CID) cell where selected ions fragment; critical to triple quad function and a separate module.
Final mass filter analyzing fragment ions; integral and always present in triple quad instruments.
Maintains ultra-high vacuum required for ion transmission and mass analysis; distinct subsystem with dedicated pumps and chambers.
Converts ion signals into measurable electronic output; a separate component essential for data acquisition.
Includes control boards, software interfaces, and data processing hardware, procured as distinct modules for instrument operation and analysis.
Sometimes included in system design for calibration or alignment, but not universally present or standardized.
Structural housing for all components, typically supplied as a complete assembly essential for integration and protection.
